name: Ugly Chic
summary: Ugly chic is a fashion style prominently from the Early 2020s intentionally embracing clashing patterns, 1960s/1980s radical-inspired, awkward proportions to subvert traditional standards of beauty and unconventional aesthetics.
description: Ugly chic is a fashion style prominently from the Early 2020s intentionally embracing clashing patterns, 1960s/1980s radical-inspired, awkward proportions to subvert traditional standards of beauty and unconventional aesthetics. Popularized by high-fashion houses such Miuccia Prada whose style thrives on nostalgia, irony, and "good taste in bad taste." tranforming historically mundane or uncoll garments into avant-garde, high-status statements.
